svg.title: Croatia study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Istria near Motovun; 2: Pelješac; 3: Korčula; 4: Slavonia near Kutjevo; 5: Danube near Ilok; 6: Plešivica; 7: Zagreb; 8: Split; 9: Osijek; 10: Zadar; 11: Pula; 12: Dubrovnik

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
